conformance.label: Conformance
conformance.validated: Validated against the pinned official artifacts
conformance.explanation: Structural recognition is not a conformance claim. A conformance verdict requires a pinned official artifact set, whose identifier and hash are reported with the result.

validation.currencyFormat: The currency must be a three-letter alphabetic code.
validation.currencyDecimalPlaces: Minor units must be between zero and four.
validation.linesRequired: At least one invoice line is required.
validation.tooManyLines: An invoice cannot contain more than {{maximum}} lines.
validation.lineIdentifierDuplicated: The line identifier '{{identifier}}' is used more than once.
validation.lineQuantityPositive: Line {{position}} requires a quantity greater than zero.
validation.lineUnitPriceNonNegative: Line {{position}} cannot have a negative unit price.
validation.lineTaxRateRange: Line {{position}} requires a tax rate between zero and 100.
validation.dueDateBeforeIssueDate: The due date cannot be earlier than the issue date.
validation.buyerReferenceRecommended: XRechnung normally requires a buyer reference (BT-10).
validation.partyCountryCodeFormat: The {{role}} country must be a two-letter code.
validation.standardUnsupported: This electronic-invoice standard is not supported.

attach.title: Attach to an existing PDF
attach.strategyIncremental: The original pages are kept byte for byte and the invoice is appended as a new revision.
attach.strategyConversion: The source must be converted to PDF/A-3b first, which rewrites the file.
attach.approveReplacement: Approve replacing the existing invoice attachment
attach.approveInconsistent: Attach even though the values were not found in the visible page
attach.blocked: The attachment was blocked. The original file is unchanged.

consistency.label: PDF and XML comparison
consistency.consistent: The invoice values were found in the visible page.
consistency.reviewRequired: Some invoice values were not found in the visible page; review it.
consistency.notEvaluated: No extractable page text was available, so no comparison was made.

evidence.revalidated: Revalidated against the current artifact set
evidence.empty: No validation has been recorded yet.

template.title: INVOICE
template.conformanceNote: The embedded invoice XML is the legally relevant data. Structural recognition by PXA is not a conformance claim.
template.standardDescription: Seller and buyer blocks, a line table, a tax breakdown and the payable total.
template.compactDescription: The standard layout without a per-rate tax breakdown, for the MINIMUM and BASIC WL profiles.

boundaries.title: Outside PXA
boundaries.description: PXA produces, embeds, reads and validates invoice documents. Peppol transport, national tax submission, accounting and legal retention are separate integrations.
